parts.name: Wheel
parts.Basic_description: A circular rubber wheel attached to the bottom rear of the trashcan, used for mobility.
parts.Functional_description: Enables the trashcan to be rolled easily when tilted backward for transport.
parts.Movement_description: Rotates around its central axle to allow smooth rolling motion.

parts.name: Wheel
parts.Basic_description: A second rubber wheel identical to the first, located on the opposite side of the trashcan base.
parts.Functional_description: Works in tandem with the first wheel to balance and support the trashcan during movement.
parts.Movement_description: Rotates around its axle, synchronized with the opposite wheel for stable rolling.

parts.name: Lid
parts.Basic_description: A flat, hinged plastic cover that seals the top of the trashcan.
parts.Functional_description: Prevents odors from escaping and keeps debris contained; can be lifted to deposit waste.
parts.Movement_description: Rotates upward around a hinge axis to open and downward to close.

parts.name: Base Body
parts.Basic_description: The main container structure of the trashcan, forming the storage compartment for waste.
parts.Functional_description: Holds and supports the waste load, connects to the wheels and lid, and provides handles for movement.
parts.Movement_description: Stationary during use; can tilt backward when pulled to roll on wheels.
